## Summary

Describe the problem and the resulting user-visible behavior. Link the related issue.

## Review notes

Include before/after screenshots for UI changes and any important tradeoffs.
Delete this section if it is not needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Tested the affected user flow
- [ ] Documentation reflects any changed behavior

## Setup changes

List migrations, new environment variable names, or cloud configuration.
Write “None” if no setup changes are needed. Never include secrets.
